Name: Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Style
Author: Jupm
Description:
[center][color=#ea9999][size=6][b]﻿☆ Welcome to Farmer Portraits - Nyapu's Sty[/b][/size][/color][color=#ea9999][size=6][b]le ☆[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]You can now choose to use only the portraits you want! Want to use only the seasons? You can! Only seasons and the Egg Festival for some reason? You can![/size][/color][/b]
[color=#ea9999][size=3]All options are set to false by default, so just enable and configure what you want to use.[/size][/color]

[size=3]Remember, all images in this mod were made using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=description]Nyapu's[/url][size=3] drawings as reference, making this mod compatible with their portraits. So I recommend downloading Nyapu's portraits to have artistic consistency in the game.
[/size]
[size=3]About the mod: This mod allows you to configure the farmer's portrait when you play, without having to close and change the confg file. It has configuration options for seasons, events, pajamas, locations and weather. You can choose between a male or female farmer and everything should update itself to match.
＊Make sure the "UseCustomPortrait" and "PortraitReactions" in the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]FarmerPortraits for 1.6[/url][size=3] folder is set to true (Path: \Mods\FarmerPortraits\config.json), or the mod won't work[/size]

[size=3]Below I will leave a guide to the configuration options (In the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29697?tab=videos]videos tab[/url][size=3], I will leave a video showing how everything works within the game)[/size]

[size=3]First choice, you can define whether your farmer will be male or female, simply marking the "masculine" option as true or falseThen you need to choose a skin tone, you will define this in the [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Body"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] section, you can also define whether or not you will have [/size][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]"Elf-ears"[/b][/size][/color][size=3] by marking it true or false.
[/size][center]﻿[/center]                                                           [img]https://i.ibb.co/RGDtHXL5/1.png[/img]

[size=3]You can choose a face type in [/size][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]"Eyes Style"[/b][/size][/color][size=3] and eye color in [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Eyes Color"[/size][/color][/b][size=3], You can also choose a detail for the face that will be the same in all seasons and events:[/size]

                                                           [img]https://i.ibb.co/Jw2PdXCr/2.jpg[/img]

[size=3] You can choose a [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Beard"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] type for the male portrait, and you can define whether the reactions will have hands appearing in the portraits by checking the [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Other"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] option as true:[/size]

                                                          [img]https://i.ibb.co/GfvzKfXy/3.jpg[/img]

[b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Hair colors"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] will define the front and back hair, as well as the beard color:[/size]

                                                         [img]https://i.ibb.co/MykMTgBR/4.png[/img]

[size=3]From now on, options can be customized differently according to the season and event. Starting with the [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Front Hair"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] and [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Back Hair"[/size][/color][/b][size=3]:[/size]

                                                        [img]https://i.ibb.co/9kRhxnTC/5.jpg[/img]
                                                        [img]https://i.ibb.co/N2q9BgV4/6.png[/img]

[b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Clothing"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] style, and you can also choose the [/size][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Clothing Color"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] you want to wear:[/size]

                                                        [img]https://i.ibb.co/HLKhXBxJ/7.jpg[/img]
                                                        [img]https://i.ibb.co/pvX2fY2L/8.png[/img]

[b][color=#ea9999][size=4]"Face Acc"[/size][/color][/b][size=3] will appear over the clothes and details, [/size][color=#ea9999][size=4][b]"Acc"[/b][/size][/color][size=3] are the hats, they will appear together with Face Acc, so you can choose to use both together:

[/size] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/DgQyRQWh/9.jpg[/img]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/6Rr0RHWX/10.png[/img]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/XkCXGYKc/11.jpg[/img]

[b][color=#ea9999][size=5]﻿[center]☆ Credits and Thanks ☆[/center][/size][/color][/b][size=3]First of all, thank you so much Nyapu for the incredible drawings you make and for allowing us to use them, I used a lot of their drawings as a base and reference so that this mod can exist!
Thank you very much [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KoalaNet13]KoalaNet13[/url][size=3] for making the Dynamic Tokens for the mod, enabling the new configurations for the portraits!
Thank you [/size][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194222676-redwaltz01/]RedWaltz01[/url][size=3] for the LightBrown, Green and Purple hair colors, and also by the navy blue color of the clothes.
Thank you [/size][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194202314-stellaresscence/]Stellaresscence[/url][size=3] for inspiring me to do the MBangs, BrownVest and the PowderPink hair color, and for making the Bandana_Brown, Beanie_Brown and SunflowerHat.
Thank you [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280]Blossom5280[/url][size=3] for the AfroPonytail, Bandana_Blue, Beanie_Purple, WitchHat_Sunflower, RoundGlasses, all the Ribbons, FlowerCrown and Scarf recolors, CyanBlue hair color and for inspiring me to do the new Tiaras and Veils.[/size]
[size=3]Thank you [/size][size=2][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ZRen12]ZRen12[/url][/size][size=3] for so many recolors, Blue, DarkBlue, PastelBlue, PastelGreen, PastelPink, PastelPurple, Pink and Violet.[/size]
